rules.rationale: This is the macro equation expanding the fresh proof term madBody into the translated statement sequence, so it is a definitional abbreviation rather than an execution rule or additional theorem.
This is the empty-sequence base equation for the newly defined recursive domain predicate allFloatVS.
This is the cons recurrence for the newly defined allFloatVS predicate and structurally descends on the sequence tail.

This simplification rule asserts a definedness characterization for the pre-existing partial Val-to-Float cast; it is an additional mathematical fact, and Stage 1 does not first prove its exact statement in a module omitting the rule.
This guarded equation defines the fresh total proof symbol projectFloat in terms of the existing partial cast on the domain where that cast is defined.
This is the reverse normalization orientation of the same guarded defining equation for the fresh projectFloat proof symbol, making the cast canonicalize to that named term.
This simplification equation gives projectFloat its identity case on values already of sort Float and therefore defines the fresh projection helper.

This simplification rule adds a guarded equality for the pre-existing applyBin operation at the dynamic Val sort; it is not a definition of a fresh symbol, and prove.sh does not establish the exact equality before compiling it.
This simplification rule adds the analogous guarded subtraction equality for the pre-existing applyBin operation, and no rule-free Stage 1 proof first establishes its exact statement.
This is the empty-sequence base equation defining the fresh left-fold summary sumFloatVS.
This is the structurally recursive cons equation defining sumFloatVS by one addF step followed by the tail fold.
This is the empty-sequence base equation defining the fresh deviationFloatVS fold summary.
This is the structurally recursive cons equation defining deviationFloatVS through subtraction, absolute value, addition, and the tail fold.
This guarded equation defines the zero-length branch of the fresh result summary madResult.
This complementary guarded equation defines the nonzero-length branch of madResult using the two fold summaries and the supplied division term.
